messages:
Jenna (People Ops): Quick heads-up — we're opening a few pop-up calibration/coverage slots over the next 48h to help with timezone overflow and reviewer conflicts. If you need to swap or pick up extra slots, please sign up on the sheet and mention any handoff notes here.

Ryan: Are these swaps going to change when the review forms lock? I have a reviewer that might be blocked if we move things.

Jenna (People Ops): Good question — locks are fixed at the published cutoff. Swaps only reassign reviewer ownership; make sure to do the handback checklist (see below) so nothing gets left half-complete.

Alec: I can cover APAC morning Tue if needed. Which form version should I be using?

Jenna (People Ops): Use the Cycle2026-Q1 form (same as the rest of the cycle) — link: https://redwood.internal/reviews/forms. No mid-cycle form changes.

peopleops-bot: Reminder scheduled — "Pop-up calibration slots open" at 2026-03-25 09:00 UTC.

Maria: Can someone take my 3pm PST slot tomorrow? I'll be on emergency leave. @Alec?

Alec: I can pick it up. Please DM me the handback checklist or drop it here.

Jenna (People Ops): Handback checklist (paste into comment when you transfer ownership):
```
- Confirm all review comments saved
- Mark reviewer assignment in the form (top-right)
- Add a short note in the form: "SWAP: from @Maria to @Alec; reason: LOA"
- Attach any supporting docs to the review thread
- Add to calibration sample if flagged
```

Tom: Quick rubric Q — are we still on rubric v2 for calibration sampling? I had a reviewer asking if criteria changed.

Jenna (People Ops): Affirmative — rubric v2 remains for this cycle. If you want to propose changes for next cycle, open a PR in the reviews-docs repo and tag @People-Ops. Do not alter rubrics mid-cycle.

Ryan: I'll post the sign-up sheet here for visibility: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-example-signup

Jenna (People Ops): Thanks all :thumbsup: Final reminder — when you swap, leave a brief comment in the form and notify the original assignee in the thread so audit logs are clear. If anything urgent pops up, DM me or ping #people-ops-escalations.
